title: OpenClaw HubSpot Automation: Let Your Agent Run Your CRM
summary: Use OpenClaw to automate HubSpot CRM tasks: lead research, deal updates, pipeline summaries, follow-up emails. Run 24/7 with Blink Claw from about $45/month per agent.
body_markdown: HubSpot allows 100 API requests per 10 seconds on most plans (higher on Enterprise). A well-written HEARTBEAT.md that batches requests — pulling all deals in one call rather than looping per deal — stays well within this limit. For high-volume pipelines (500+ deals), consider adding a delay between operations or using HubSpot's search API with filters to reduce result sets. OpenClaw agents handle HTTP 429 errors gracefully by default and will retry after the rate limit window resets.
